tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window ground: sidebar and behind everything.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The reading surface: every main page (meeting, home, wallet, settings).

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Things that float or that you operate: the live pill, toasts, sheets, menus, ⌘K, cards you act on, the selected row.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: inputs, proof hash, recovery words.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, notes, names, amounts (13:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text that you still read: summaries under titles, row descriptions, button labels on quiet buttons (10:1+).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata only: times, counts, the eyebrow over a title (5.0:1+). Never a whole paragraph.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Icons, meter tracks, decorative marks only. Never text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows. Decorative; never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3.2:1+).

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: The one accent: the primary button, links, selection, your side of the conversation, Verified and Paid (6.1:1+).

tokens.name: verdigris-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on verdigris fills and links.

tokens.name: on-verdigris
tokens.usage: Label on a verdigris fill (7.4:1+).

tokens.name: verdigris-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of Verified and Paid pills, your transcript bubbles, the You avatar.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Recording only (dot, timer, Stop) and Failed (4.7:1+).

tokens.name: record-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the recording state and Failed pills.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: A person must look: Blocked payments, consent, silent audio (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: caution-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of Blocked and consent notices.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Meeting titles and onboarding headings. One per view.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Greeting, sheet titles, the big card title on Home.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Summaries, decisions, your notes, transcript bubbles.
styles.sample: Ada and Victor agreed the API fix ships before Friday.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “pay the designer the fifty dollar deposit today”

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section titles in sentence case, with a muted count after: “Follow-ups 3”. Replaces the uppercase label.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The one quiet line above a title (project · date · length). Sentence case, muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Accounts, amounts in rows, hashes, times. Tabular figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: An amount on a card you act on.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: One hero number per view: the wallet balance, the recording timer.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; avatar stack overlap is -6px.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and pill padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding for follow-ups and Home cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side padding; space above a display title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, checkboxes, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards you act on: follow-ups, Home cards, the payee list.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: sheets, ⌘K, the menu bar panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the live recording pill, meters.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards you act on, at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: A card under the pointer, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: The live recording pill and toasts.
